queries.cypher: CALL db.idx.fulltext.queryNodes('Premise', $q) YIELD node, score RETURN node.id, node.text, score ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT $limit
UNWIND $ids AS pid MATCH (pr:Premise {id: pid}) OPTIONAL MATCH (d:Decision)-[:BECAUSE_OF|DERIVED_FROM*1..6]->(pr) RETURN pid, count(DISTINCT d)
MATCH (pr:Premise {id: $id}) MATCH p = (d:Decision)-[:BECAUSE_OF|DERIVED_FROM*1..4]->(pr) RETURN d.id, d.title, nodes(p), length(p) ORDER BY length(p)

MATCH (d:Decision) OPTIONAL MATCH (n:Decision)-[su:SUPERSEDES]->(d) WHERE su.at <= $as_of AND coalesce(su.stated, su.at) <= $as_of OPTIONAL MATCH (x:Evidence)-[rt:RETIRES]->(d) WHERE rt.at <= $as_of AND coalesce(rt.stated, rt.at) <= $as_of WITH d, coalesce(n.id, x.id) AS sup OPTIONAL MATCH p = (d)-[:BECAUSE_OF|DERIVED_FROM*1..4]->(pr:Premise) OPTIONAL MATCH (e)-[r:SUPPORTS|CONTRADICTS]->(pr) WHERE r.at <= $as_of AND coalesce(r.stated, r.at) <= $as_of WITH d, sup, pr, collect({rel: type(r), at: r.at, stated: r.stated, kind: e.kind}) AS ev OPTIONAL MATCH (d)-[:GOVERNS]->(s:System) RETURN d, sup, pr.id, ev, collect(DISTINCT s.name) ORDER BY d.id

MATCH (p:Person)-[o:OWNS]->(d:Decision) WHERE o.valid_from <= $as_of AND ($id IS NULL OR d.id = $id) RETURN d.id, p.id, p.name, p.role, o.valid_from, o.valid_to, o.handed_over_from ORDER BY d.id, o.valid_from
